name: Junior Achievement high school programs (JA Company Program, JA Job Shadow, JA Inspire)
city: Los Angeles area, Orange County and Inland Empire, CA
what_you_do: In a class or club, students learn money skills, build and run a small business with a pitch contest, or visit employers for job shadow events. JA Inspire is a career fair with mock interviews.
who_can_apply: High school students whose school or group requests a program. The page does not say whether individual teens can sign up. JA Finance Park is the Los Angeles area only.
pay_detail: No pay. The page says programs are offered at little or no cost to educators.
deadline_text: Schools request programs any time. JA Inspire 2027 is Mar 10 to 11, 2027 at JA Finance Park in Los Angeles. Registration was not open yet.
how_to_apply: Ask your school to request a program using the form on the JA high school page. The page does not say who should fill it in. Contact: info@jasocal.org or 323-957-1818.
notes: The page does not say whether teens can sign up alone. Bring the page to a teacher. JA Company Program ends with the JA Student Entrepreneurship Challenge pitch contest.
